title: Trump Declares 'Liberation Day' and Tariffs Nearly Every Country
dek: From the Rose Garden, Trump sets a 10% tariff on nearly all imports and higher rates on dozens of countries; the S&P 500 sheds $5 trillion in two days.
body: A 10% tariff on nearly all imports, up to 50% on some. The Supreme Court struck it down in February 2026.

panels.label: Trump Said
panels.text: Trump called the tariffs “our declaration of economic independence” after decades of being “looted, pillaged, raped, and plundered.”

panels.label: Beijing Said
panels.text: China’s commerce ministry called them “a typical unilateral bullying practice” and vowed to “fight to the end.”

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: Both sides speak of fairness; at stake is whether access to the US market can be rationed to pull factories home, and who may set the price.
